name: rocimail
description: Zoho-Mail-style webmail client built on JMAP (Stalwart) with IMAP support for secondary accounts

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace server & npm run dev --workspace web & wait
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace alarm-dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web && npm run typecheck --workspace alarm-dashboard
